title: Domaine Queylus
specs: Located atop the Niagara Escarpment in the Niagara Peninsula wine region
Sustainable viticulture with organic (uncertified) practices and hand care
Wines aged 16-18 months in French oak barrels from selected Burgundian coopers
gap: Duration of tasting experience not stated
blurb: Domaine Queylus crafts wines from Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc, and Merlot grown on their vineyards atop the Niagara Escarpment. They practice sustainable viticulture with organic methods and hand care of vines. Visitors can sample wines in the tasting room and enjoy food pairings on the patio in summer.
extraNote: Tasting room at 3651 Sixteen Rd, St. Anns ON L0R 1Y0
